# Build the tiny todo app

## Task 1: Add the todo model

Create the model and its tests.
**Files:** `todo/model.py`, `tests/test_model.py:12-28`
Run: `python -m pytest tests/test_model.py`

## Task 2: Add the todo screen

Consumes: Task 1
Modify: `todo/ui.py`
Run: `python -m pytest tests/test_ui.py`

## Task 3: Document the app

After Task 2, update the guide.
Test: `docs/guide.md`
Run: `git commit -m "docs"`
Run: `python -m pytest`
